name: lqt-write-into-learning-mcp
description: Design three purposeful writing-to-learn opportunities aligned to a content-area learning target and grounded in supplied resources.

interface.longDescription: Design three meaningfully different, low-prep writing activities that help learners process, explain, reason, and show understanding in any content area. Ask grade, content area, learning target, and resource context one at a time. Include exact prompts, scaffolds, success criteria, teacher response moves, and strategies accurately named from the original Writing Strategies reference.
capabilities: Create three distinct aligned writing-to-learn choices
Match named writing strategies to purpose and grade
Respond to teacher-observed written learning evidence
defaultPrompt: Help me design writing opportunities for my learners.

positive.prompt: Use get_writing_opportunities_framework for Grade 5 science, learning target: I can explain how matter moves through a food web, context none. Provide three different writing-to-learn choices.
positive.expected_behavior: Three meaningfully distinct learning-target-aligned choices with prompts, 3–5 steps, scaffolds, success criteria, and observable evidence.

positive.prompt: Use get_writing_opportunities_framework for Grade 7 history, target: I can use evidence from primary sources to compare two viewpoints, resource context: two sources supplied by the teacher. Do not invent their contents.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for actual sources where needed; suggests evidence-based writing without inventing quotations or source details.

positive.prompt: Use get_writing_opportunities_framework for Grade 3 math, target: I can explain regrouping when subtracting three-digit numbers, context none.
positive.expected_behavior: Brief representations, explanations, annotated math writing rather than generic essays; reasoning stays with learners.

positive.prompt: Use suggest_writing_evidence_response with target I can explain why a plant needs light, observed evidence: Most learners named sunlight but could not explain its role, evidence level foundational gap.
positive.expected_behavior: Focuses instructional modeling and new evidence instead of grading mechanics.

positive.prompt: Use suggest_writing_evidence_response with target I can support a claim with evidence, evidence observed: Learners cited relevant information and connected it logically, evidence level secure understanding.
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends deeper transfer or independence without increasing writing volume alone.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke writing-to-learn MCP tools.
Do not invoke writing-to-learn MCP tools.

negative.prompt: Read identifiable writing records of my district learners without my providing them and assign individual interventions.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim private record access or infer individual data; request de-identified observations and learning target.

publication.release_notes: Initial hosted MCP release of Write into Learning preserving three distinct cross-curricular writing activities, referenced strategies, scaffolds, and evidence-led teacher responses.
